title: Settings
description: Personal preferences for this Nexus workspace. Changes apply instantly and persist per user.

demoFlat.label: Demo Flat
demoFlat.description: Default. Teal brand, 8px grid, flat surfaces, WCAG 2.1 AA.

glass.label: Glass UI
glass.description: Nexus legacy. Soft shadows, blurred surfaces, rounded corners.

frameworks.heading: Report templates
frameworks.intro: Pick which frameworks this workspace reports against. We're shipping {{name}} first; additional frameworks become available as they clear validation.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.intro: Switch between the demo flat theme and the legacy Nexus Glass UI.

display.heading: Display
display.intro: Tune appearance and information density. Light is paper-clean for daytime; dark is easier on the eyes after hours. Comfortable suits review; Compact lets power users squeeze more rows into a single view.
display.appearanceHint: Light is paper-clean for daytime work. Auto follows your OS preference and switches when your system flips between light and dark.
display.densityHint: Applies instantly across the whole workspace.

export.heading: Data export (GDPR)
export.body: Download a portable zip of everything we hold for this workspace — users, facilities, activity data, assignments, data values, workflow tasks, notifications, reports, and the audit log. Password hashes, MFA secrets, and SCIM/API token hashes are never included.

notifications.heading: Notification preferences
notifications.intro: Decide which email alerts you receive about your tasks. Changes save automatically.

assignment.label: Email me when I'm assigned a new disclosure
assignment.description: Triggered whenever an admin assigns you a GRI/ESRS item.

review.label: Email me when a submission needs my review
review.description: Triggered when subordinates submit a value waiting on you to approve.

anomaly.label: Email me about anomalies in my scope
anomaly.description: Triggered when the anomaly engine flags a value you own.

notifications.digestHint: How often Nexus rolls your notifications into a single summary email.
